summary: Controlled selector for ticket types and quantities for an event.
whenToUse: Presenting ticket options and availability before registration.
whenNotToUse: Handling payments, orders, or server-side availability: these responsibilities stay with the consumer.

props.name: selectedTicketId
props.description: Selected ID, controlled by the consumer.

props.name: quantity
props.description: Current quantity, controlled by the consumer.

keyboard.action: Navigates the native radio buttons; Tab reaches the quantity field.

accessibility: Uses fieldset and legend for the radio group; each choice has a label, and unavailable tickets are disabled.
responsive: Options adapt to narrow spaces and move the price below the name on small viewports.
customization: Surfaces, borders, and typography use --dc-* tokens; className is applied to the section.
commonMistakes: Do not attach purchase or payment callbacks: the component only provides controlled selection.
limits: Does not make bookings or payments.
